tagline: Beautiful Plants, Expertly Grown & Ready for Your Garden
areas: Newcastle · South Shields · East Boldon · Hebburn · Sunderland
about_1: Tubs & Shrubs has built an enviable reputation across the North East for the range and quality of plants we supply. George is an experienced grower and garden designer, having trained at Houghall Horticultural College.
about_2: From million bells trailers and French marigolds to Rhododendrons and Hydrangeas — we bring exceptional plants directly to you at prices that make your garden dreams achievable.
contact_intro: Stock changes fast — the best way to know what's available is to follow us on Facebook or give George a call. We're out early most mornings topping the shelves up.
